title: Orbit of fixed-width binary increment
statement: For every width $w$ and every natural number $i<2^w$, iterating the operation that increments a little-endian Boolean word when possible and leaves it unchanged on overflow, $i$ times from the all-false word of length $w$ gives the length-$w$ little-endian binary representation of $i$, with leading zeros retained.
replaced:
For every width $w$ and every $i < 2^w$, iterating the stalled fixed-width
increment (increment, keeping the word unchanged on overflow) $i$ times from the
all-false word of length $w$ yields the width-$w$ little-endian binary word of
$i$. Nothing is asserted at the terminal rank $2^w$.
